faq.q: What does the name Aadilat mean?
faq.a: Aadilat means Just women; justice (ʿādilāt / ʿadālat).

faq.q: What is the origin of the name Aadilat?
What language does the name Aadilat come from?
faq.a: Aadilat is used in Arabic, Urdu.

faq.q: Is Aadilat a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aadilat is used as a female name.

faq.q: How is Aadilat written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aadilat is written عادلات in Arabic and عادلات in Urdu, and आदिलात in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aadilat?
faq.a: The root of Aadilat is ع-د-ل (ʿ-d-l).

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aadilat?
faq.a: Feminine plural of Arabic ʿādilah; cf. ʿadālat, justice.

faq.q: Does Aadilat appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: Not a Qur'anic name; formed from the Arabic root ʿ-d-l.
It is the feminine plural of ʿādilah, 'just women'; it also stands near the noun ʿadālat, 'justice'.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aadilat?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aadilat total 21, reducing to 3. Number 3 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aadilat?
faq.a: Aadilat appears with variants and alternative spellings such as Adilat, Aadilaat.

faq.q: Which names are related to Aadilat?
faq.a: Names sharing form or root with Aadilat include Aadila, Aadilan.
Yes. Both come from the root ʿ-d-l: Aadila is ʿādilah, and Aadilat is its feminine plural.

faq.q: Where is the name Aadilat used today?
faq.a: Aadilat is used in Arabic, Urdu naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it, so no popularity score is asserted.
